payload.title: Exploring the Dry Tortugas Sr/Ca data
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook, authored by Deborah Khider, explores the calibration of coral Sr/Ca measurements to sea surface temperature (SST) in the Dry Tortugas. It utilizes data from NOAA NCEI and employs various Python libraries for data analysis and visualization. The notebook examines the relationship between coral Sr/Ca ratios and SST, using statistical techniques such as Pearson's correlation. Outputs include time series plots, scatter plots, and correlation coefficients, providing insights into the paleoclimatic conditions of the region.
goals: Calibrate coral Sr/Ca measurements to sea surface temperature.
Explore the relationship between coral Sr/Ca ratios and SST.
Visualize data through time series and scatter plots.
Compute correlations between coral records and instrumental datasets.
